meta.title: Ability Shop
meta.subtitle: Wario's Warehouse — Training Wing
meta.warioPitch: Wario does not 'teach' for coin anymore. Training is paid in Ability Points, earned by levelling. Wario is furious about this. No refunds, no lawsuits, no exceptions.
meta.note: Abilities are unlocked with Ability Points (AP), not gold. AP is auto-calculated from each character's XP level - see data/abilityPoints.json and tools/build_ability_points.py. The legacy `price` field below is retained for history only and is NOT used by the shop.
meta.source: Liberated Toads faction XP docket; original Training Wing abilities
meta.apCostRule: Shared pool costs: levels 1-4 = 1 AP, 5-8 = 2 AP, 9-12 = 3 AP, 13+ = 4 AP
meta.trainingRestriction: Core Liberated Toad docket only; Waluigi and Mole excluded; underlevel training permitted with lawful-conduct drawback.

abilities.name: Lantern Code
abilities.description: learns to turn a crowded street into a readable map without alarming bystanders. This module is original to the Liberated Toad docket and is not an upgrade of another ability.

abilities.name: Whisper Net
abilities.description: creates a low-tech communication chain that survives distance and bad weather. This module is original to the Liberated Toad docket and is not an upgrade of another ability.

abilities.name: Safehouse Cartography
abilities.description: keeps a refuge supplied, quiet, and accountable to its neighbors. This module is original to the Liberated Toad docket and is not an upgrade of another ability.

abilities.name: Riverbank Signals
abilities.description: reads current, mud, and broken reeds to choose a safer crossing. This module is original to the Liberated Toad docket and is not an upgrade of another ability.

abilities.name: Quiet Muster
abilities.description: organizes a mixed crew before panic can turn into disorder. This module is original to the Liberated Toad docket and is not an upgrade of another ability.

abilities.name: Breadline Triage
abilities.description: keeps a ration line moving while identifying anyone who needs urgent care. This module is original to the Liberated Toad docket and is not an upgrade of another ability.

abilities.name: Barrel Seal
abilities.description: checks seals and provenance before a communal storehouse accepts a delivery. This module is original to the Liberated Toad docket and is not an upgrade of another ability.

abilities.name: Rooftop Relay
abilities.description: passes a message across rooftops using ordinary objects and agreed timing. This module is original to the Liberated Toad docket and is not an upgrade of another ability.

abilities.name: Witness Lantern
abilities.description: preserves testimony without leading the witness or losing the important detail. This module is original to the Liberated Toad docket and is not an upgrade of another ability.

abilities.name: Ferry Route
abilities.description: plans a ferry crossing around tide, cargo, and the least confident swimmer. This module is original to the Liberated Toad docket and is not an upgrade of another ability.

abilities.name: Counterfeit Test
abilities.description: spots forged marks by comparing pressure, wear, and the maker’s habits. This module is original to the Liberated Toad docket and is not an upgrade of another ability.

abilities.name: Bellweather Watch
abilities.description: uses weather signs to decide when a patrol should shelter rather than push on. This module is original to the Liberated Toad docket and is not an upgrade of another ability.

abilities.name: Maproom Courtesy
abilities.description: greets a wary official in a way that opens a door without surrendering leverage. This module is original to the Liberated Toad docket and is not an upgrade of another ability.

abilities.name: Rainproof Ledger
abilities.description: keeps ink, paper, and records usable after rain or an unexpected river dunking. This module is original to the Liberated Toad docket and is not an upgrade of another ability.

abilities.name: Evacuation Knot
abilities.description: ties a group together during a hurried evacuation so nobody vanishes unnoticed. This module is original to the Liberated Toad docket and is not an upgrade of another ability.

abilities.name: Market Daylight
abilities.description: makes a public transaction visible enough to discourage quiet exploitation. This module is original to the Liberated Toad docket and is not an upgrade of another ability.

abilities.name: Bridgekeeper Sense
abilities.description: anticipates the structural habits of bridges, gates, and the people who guard them. This module is original to the Liberated Toad docket and is not an upgrade of another ability.

abilities.name: Powder Trail
abilities.description: follows residue and disturbance without treating every footprint as proof. This module is original to the Liberated Toad docket and is not an upgrade of another ability.

abilities.name: Campfire Rotation
abilities.description: switches camp duties cleanly so fatigue does not become a tactical weakness. This module is original to the Liberated Toad docket and is not an upgrade of another ability.

abilities.name: Doorway Count
abilities.description: counts exits and occupants at a glance before a room becomes dangerous. This module is original to the Liberated Toad docket and is not an upgrade of another ability.

abilities.name: Night Ferry
